title: Ho Latola Har'a Bongata
intro: U iphumana u le har'a batho bao limmaraka tsa bona li tletseng khoebo, empa sekala sa bona se ntse se thekesela ka bolotsana. Lenģosa le tlile ho bona ka litemoso tse hlakileng, empa ba tšeha 'me ba furalla, ba kholisehile ka katleho ea bona. Leholimo le qala ho fifala, empa ba le bona e le tlhohonolofatso ea pula. Batho bana ke bo-mang?
clues: Re ile ra atleha linaheng tsa khoebo le tse ngata, empa lipelo tsa rona li ile tsa thatafala.
Moromuoa o tlile ho rona ka lipontšo tse tsoang ho Morena oa rona, empa ra soma litemoso tsa hae.
Re ne re tsebahala ka mosebetsi oa rona, empa re ne re fana ka tekanyo e khutšoanyane 'me re qhekella batho.
Re ne re phela har'a lifate tse teteaneng le limela tse tala, empa re ne re nka litlhohonolofatso tsa rona habobebe.
Ha leru le letšo le atamela, re ile ra thaba, re nahana hore le tla nesa pula naheng ea rona e omeletseng.
Ho ena le hoo, leru leo ​​le ile la lokolla kotlo e chesang, mme ra tshwarwa ke tlhokofatso ya letsatsi la moriti.

identity.label: Re Bo-mang?
options: Ashab al-Aykah (Balekane ba Moru)
Batho ba Thamud
Batho ba 'Ad
Batho ba Lute
Batho ba Nuh

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: Ba ile ba hana lenģosa la bona mme ba qhekella khoebong
Ba ile ba rapela namane ea khauta 'me ba khelosoa
Ba ne ba etsa bosodoma 'me ba hlasela baeti
Ba hahile litora tse telele 'me ba phephetsa Molimo
Ba hanne ho arolelana metsi mme ba lematsa kamele e tshehadi
trial.answer: Ba ile ba hana lenģosa la bona mme ba qhekella khoebong

location.label: Karolo ea Bohlokoa
options: Moru o teteaneng kapa moru o teteaneng
Thaba e betliloeng matlong
Motse o pela lewatle
Phula ea lehoatata e nang le liliba
Serapa se nonneng se nang le litholoana tse ngata
location.answer: Moru o teteaneng kapa moru o teteaneng

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: Ho senngoa ke leru la mollo le moriti
Ho koaheloa ke moroallo o moholo
E metse ke tšisinyeho ea lefatše
Ho otloa ke moea o matla
E fetotsoe lejoe
outcome.answer: Ho senngoa ke leru la mollo le moriti

verse: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway. (15:79)
